component.name: Inkcut C++
component.summary: Drive vinyl cutters, plotters and engravers from SVG/DXF/bitmap input
Sterowanie ploterami tnącymi i grawerkami z plików SVG/DXF/bitmap

description.p: Inkcut C++ is a Qt6 reimplementation of the Inkcut workflow: load an SVG, DXF or bitmap (via potrace), apply geometry filters (blade offset, min-line, repeats, weedlines), order the cuts and send HPGL / DMPL / GPGL / G-code / CAMM commands over a serial port or save them to a file.

Inkcut C++ to port łańcucha cięcia Inkcut do C++/Qt6: import SVG, DXF lub bitmapy (przez potrace), filtry geometrii (offset ostrza, min. linia, powtórki, linie tnące), kolejność cięcia i wysyłka HPGL / DMPL / GPGL / G-code / CAMM na port szeregowy lub do pliku.

ul.li: SVG, DXF and bitmap import (potrace + mkbitmap-like preprocessing)
HPGL, DMPL, GPGL, G-code and CAMM output
Copies, rotation, mirroring, weedlines, blade-offset compensation
Material roll, custom force / speed (HPGL FS/VS)
Live plot view, job history, device console

component.developer_name: pratanczuk and contributors (port of Inkcut by Jairus Martin et al.)

description.p: Initial public release of the C++/Qt6 port.

ul.li: HPGL, DMPL, GPGL, G-code, CAMM output
